sections.Profile:
The "Six Shooter" pinball machine, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in October 1966, is a six-player, electro-mechanical game with a Wild West theme. Designed by Ted Zale, it features two flippers, six mushroom bumpers, two kick-out holes, and a spinning bumper

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 6
- Tags: Western, Original Theme, Guns
